name: Raised bole red
summary: A thick slip of red clay that stands in low relief on the tile and fires to a bright tomato red under a clear glaze. It is the signature colour of Iznik tiles.
how: Make a slip of red bole clay, rich in iron.
Apply it thick with a brush, so that it stands 0.5 to 1 mm above the white ground.
Cover it with a clear glaze and fire it in an oxidising kiln.
Use it for flowers, so that red joins blue, turquoise and green.

origin.note: Iznik potters add a raised red to the palette from about 1560, after the first use on lamps for Süleyman.

adoptions.via: Iznik potters paint tulips and carnations in raised red on tiles for the mosques of Istanbul.
